name: Instruments — JD Upgraded (Ubuntu, g++-12)
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq build-essential g++-12 libstdc++-12-dev libasound2-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxcursor-dev libxinerama-dev libxext-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev
cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-12 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc-12
cmake --build build -j$(nproc)
./tests/golden/verify_golden.sh
